items.title: What Is Retrieval-Augmented Generation, aka RAG?
items.summary: Editor’s note: This article, originally published on Nov. 15, 2023, has been updated. To understand the latest advancements in generative AI , imagine a courtroom. Judges hear and decide cases based on their general understanding of the law. Sometimes a case — like a malpractice suit or a labor dispute — requires special expertise, so judges send court clerks to a law library, looking for precedents and specific case
items.summaryZh: 本文由NVIDIA AI更新发布，详细回顾了检索增强生成（RAG）技术的诞生背景与演进过程。文章采访了创造该术语的论文领衔作者Patrick Lewis，阐述了RAG如何通过外挂数据源弥补大模型通用知识库的不足，从而为各行业落地生成式AI应用提供精准、可信的检索增强能力。

items.title: OpenAI o3-mini System Card
items.summary: This report outlines the safety work carried out for the OpenAI o3-mini model, including safety evaluations, external red teaming, and Preparedness Framework evaluations.
items.summaryZh: 本文发布了OpenAI o3-mini模型的系统卡报告，全面梳理了该模型在安全性、外部红队测试以及Preparedness Framework评估中的表现。报告评估了其在高级推理任务中的潜在风险与安全对齐情况，为行业理解新一代推理模型的安全性提供了权威参考。

items.title: Mini-R1: Reproduce Deepseek R1 „aha moment“ a RL tutorial
items.summary: 来自原始信息源的最新动态，点击标题查看完整内容。
items.summaryZh: 本文由Philipp Schmid撰写并在Hugging Face发布，详细介绍了如何使用强化学习技术复现DeepSeek-R1的“aha moment”（顿悟时刻）。教程采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）算法和Countdown数独游戏任务，在4张NVIDIA H100 GPU上通过DeepSpeed与vLLM实现分布式训练，指导开源社区如何仅通过强化学习让模型自主学会自我验证和搜索推理能力。
